context.user_notes: WHEN: in ten days the university semester starts and the students start coming in from other provinces to register. WHO: young people, first-time buyers, mostly. WHAT they want: the loose stuff, the oversized tees, they don't want anything tight. DO: prioritize the young people's clothes that are stagnant, the ones that have been sitting there for months, take the brand into account, that's where they shop. DON'T: leave the adult clothes alone, those sell to older customers and they move fine even when it doesn't look like it. DON'T: don't touch the kids clothes either, that market is different and it's not the one I'm trying to grow. DON'T: the star products for young people, the ones that already sell on their own, leave those alone too, I don't want to lose margin on what already moves.
